zero_checks.duplicate_live_matchday_publications: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT matchday_id FROM federation_schedule_publication WHERE state = 'live' GROUP BY matchday_id HAVING count(*) > 1) violations
zero_checks.finalized_participant_teams_without_part: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_participant_set_line line JOIN federation_participant_set pset ON pset.id = line.participant_set_id LEFT JOIN federation_tournament_participant participant ON participant.tournament_id = pset.division_id AND participant.team_id = line.team_id AND participant.state = 'confirmed' WHERE pset.state = 'finalized' AND participant.id IS NULL
zero_checks.fixture_match_backlink_mismatches: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_fixture fixture JOIN federation_match match ON match.id = fixture.operational_match_id WHERE match.logical_fixture_id IS DISTINCT FROM fixture.id
zero_checks.matches_without_expected_team_match_shee: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_match match WHERE match.home_team_id IS NOT NULL AND match.away_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM federation_match_sheet sheet WHERE sheet.match_id = match.id AND sheet.team_id = match.home_team_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM federation_match_sheet sheet WHERE sheet.match_id = match.id AND sheet.team_id = match.away_team_id))
zero_checks.multiple_active_primary_rosters: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT team_id, season_id, COALESCE(competition_id, 0) competition_scope FROM federation_team_roster WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY team_id, season_id, COALESCE(competition_id, 0) HAVING count(*) > 1) violations
zero_checks.orphan_competition_editions: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_competition_edition edition LEFT JOIN federation_competition competition ON competition.id = edition.competition_id LEFT JOIN federation_season season ON season.id = edition.season_id WHERE competition.id IS NULL OR season.id IS NULL
zero_checks.orphan_schedule_publications: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_schedule_publication publication LEFT JOIN federation_matchday matchday ON matchday.id = publication.matchday_id WHERE matchday.id IS NULL
zero_checks.published_matches_without_published_slot: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_match WHERE schedule_publication_id IS NOT NULL AND published_slot_id IS NULL
zero_checks.published_matches_without_venue_or_playi: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_match WHERE schedule_publication_id IS NOT NULL AND (venue_id IS NULL OR playing_area_id IS NULL)
zero_checks.resolved_playable_fixtures_without_match: SELECT count(*) FROM federation_fixture fixture LEFT JOIN federation_match match ON match.logical_fixture_id = fixture.id WHERE fixture.state <> 'cancelled' AND fixture.bye_team_id IS NULL AND fixture.home_team_id IS NOT NULL AND fixture.away_team_id IS NOT NULL AND match.id IS NULL
zero_checks.retired_competition_engine_not_upgradeab: SELECT count(*) FROM ir_module_module WHERE name = 'sports_federation_competition_engine' AND state <> 'uninstalled'
zero_checks.retired_engine_legacy_tables_remaining: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name LIKE 'federation_competition_engine_%'
zero_checks.stored_attachments_without_filename: SELECT count(*) FROM ir_attachment WHERE type = 'binary' AND store_fname IS NOT NULL AND store_fname = ''
